items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially is active today vs. the Raiders despite calf injury; earlier optimism after feeling better Saturday.
items.why: Calf feeling better; McVay/sources optimistic no setbacks; no practice Friday but available.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; high volume expected with Adams out long-term.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets in depleted Rams WR room (Adams out).

items.text: Christian McCaffrey to locker room with thigh injury (questionable to return) early vs ATL then returned later; contusion more than strain per reports.
items.why: Thigh contusion after first drive TD; treated, locker, then back.
items.implication: Monitor snaps rest of game/bye next week; Kaelon Black got work/score in absence.
items.opportunity: Temporary boost to backup RB while out; CMC still workhorse if healthy.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) officially inactive; earlier unlikely after limited practice, may need another week to ramp.
items.why: Quad strain; not full participant after missing three games; worked out but early.
items.implication: Braelon Allen starts again as primary back vs MIA; strong RB2/flex.
items.opportunity: Full carries/snaps for Allen in favorable matchup.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: Puka GTD/optimism then active; Breece GTD/pessimism then inactive; Lamar OUT; Saquon expected; Smith/Wicks OUT; Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson IN.
items.implication: Update all projections/lineups; key DFS pivots on Lamar/Puka/Breece.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups/handcuffs on OUT/INACTIVE; full roles on IN.

items.text: Lamar Jackson has been downgraded to out for Sunday’s game against the Bengals due to high ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited practice then ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game less explosive, boost to Zay Flowers volume but lower ceiling overall.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Flowers/Andrews/Likely in Huntley offense.

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to play (questionable but in line) Monday vs DAL; efficient in limited games, great matchup.
items.why: Questionable but sources/ETR/Berry expect him; Dallas soft vs RBs.
items.implication: Start if active; RB1 upside with WRs out.
items.opportunity: Heavy carries + receiving with Smith/Wicks out.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs to active roster from exempt; expected to play/return vs DET.
items.implication: Workload question post-layoff; Berry hates due to rust vs DET.
items.opportunity: Lead back carries but possible committee/split early.
items.conflict: Berry fade on workload after long layoff.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks for Monday night vs Dallas.
items.why: Hamstring (Smith); both ruled out on injury report.
items.implication: AJ Brown massive target spike; Goedert elevated; Saquon if active gets more checkdowns.
items.opportunity: WR1 monopoly for Brown; TE/RB receiving boost.

items.text: Puka high in top-10 overall Week 7 rankings (around 3); active confirmation reinforces faith despite no Fri practice.
items.why: Confidence he plays; elite talent in good spot.
items.opportunity: Full target share with Adams out.

items.text: Status of Lamar (ankle), Puka (calf), Breece (quad) crucial to Sunday DFS main slate; sneaky scratches include Egbuka, Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren; tempted by CMC slot amid 49ers WR outs despite usual skepticism.
items.why: Projections updated on latest; rare buy on RB-as-WR with dire WR room + Black.
items.implication: Pivot DFS stacks; fade scratches; CMC elevated receiving role possible.
items.opportunity: CMC routes/slot; backups for scratched; Huntley/Puka stacks.
items.conflict: Usually fades RB-WR hype but usage/injury context overrides.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel OUT for 49ers; dire WR situation elevates CMC receiving and backups.
items.implication: CMC more involved in passing; Kirk activated as option; Black handcuff value.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI for usage/matchup (WR10); Bears soft, Brown back in real role with volume.
items.why: Usage + Bears matchup; elevated further with Smith/Wicks OUT.

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups; also Saquon if active, Coleman 100% roster.
items.why: Workloads + defenses carved by RBs; Coleman IR return upside.
items.implication: Start these volume backs; roster Coleman everywhere.

items.text: Broncos CB Pat Surtain II inactive (ankle); unlikely earlier, good chance back next week.
items.implication: Boost to Cardinals pass catchers (MHJ, Wilson, etc).

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (concussion/foot); sneaky important scratch per Levitan.
items.implication: Boost to other TB WRs/Godwin if active; Mayfield return helps.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6); Lions TE buffet (9 TE TDs allowed), Kraft gets the boost.
items.why: DET allows elite TE production; Kraft volume/role.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18) due to workload question after long layoff.
items.why: Rust/post-layoff role uncertainty vs tough DET.
items.implication: Fade or lower expectations despite activation.
items.conflict: ETR/Schefter activation positive but usage risk.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (shadow), Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low scoring), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D).
